provider none prints guidance and exits: is a friendly no-op when provider is none
an unsupported tracker is treated as non: treats an unsupported provider as none
provider set but no credential resolves: fails loudly when a provider is configured but no credential resolves (AC2)
an active ticket maps to an open payload: maps an active ticket to an open payload
includes the epic and type labels
a terminal ticket maps to a closed paylo: maps a %s ticket to a closed payload
a ticket with no epic yields only the ty: omits the epic label when the ticket has no epic
the linear provider routes to the Linear: routes a %s project to that writer and leaves %s untouched
the github provider routes to the GitHub: routes a %s project to that writer and leaves %s untouched
a ticket absent from a present sidecar i: creates an absent ticket and records its ref
a ticket already in the sidecar is updat: updates a recorded ticket without creating
re-sync of an active ticket touches titl: updates title and labels but never status, assignee, or priority
a newly-terminal ticket closes its issue: closes the issue on a terminal payload without writing assignee or priority
a ticket created with a pending ref is r: reconciles a pending ticket instead of creating again
a corrupt sidecar stops the run pending: refuses on a corrupt sidecar pending an explicit reset
a missing sidecar on a configured projec: refuses on a missing sidecar instead of blind-recreating (AC9)
the default body omits the spec and work: excludes the ticket body content under the minimal default
body full to a public github repo emits: warns about egress before creating when body full hits a public repo
a token is read from the environment, ne: resolves the token from the provider env var
does not accept a config object as a source (structural — config carries no token)
a CI run on an Arcade user identity is w: warns about the Arcade user-identity silent-failure mode in CI
a rate-limited write is retried with bac: retries a rate-limited create and ultimately projects the ticket
